source: vanilla 26.2 127.0.0.1:25770 official UpdateMobEffect / RemoveMobEffect plus entity_metadata effect_particles

vanillaBroadcast.self: ServerPlayer.onEffectAdded sends ClientboundUpdateMobEffectPacket to the affected player connection.
vanillaBroadcast.otherEntityObservers: LivingEntity.onEffectAdded only sendEffectToPassengers (ServerPlayer passengers). ServerEntity.sendPairingData does not include UpdateMobEffect. Nearby observers do not receive entity_effect.
vanillaBroadcast.observerVisible: SynchedEntityData DATA_EFFECT_PARTICLES / DATA_EFFECT_AMBIENCE. Particle list is display-only and does not carry effect id, amplifier or duration.
vanillaBroadcast.passenger: After the observer mounts the entity, sendEffectToPassengers emits UpdateMobEffect for already-applied and later effects.

samples.label: passenger-existing-speed
samples.notes: emitted when the auditor mounted probe-zombie that already had Speed; duration is remaining ticks

observerParticles.limits: Color is not used to invent effect id or duration in core facts.
